text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time flies by as I enjoy my trial period as
Tamamo Cross's trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well? How was that lap?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aw yes! And I'm not tired at all! Lookin'
good, me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems our hard days of training are
paying off, and she's feeling
herself get
stronger. But before the tryouts, I want to
try one more
thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A li'l test before the real deal, yeah? Good idea! I wanna see what I'm really made of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering her growth, she should have
this in the bag, but we can
still use this
opportunity to refine her form and
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or, at least, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gotta win, gotta win, gotta win! If I don't,
I'm just a...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's the final stretch, with our lead still
setting the pace! Will anyone
be able to
overtake her?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No! Why?! C'mon, legs, don't give up on
me now! We gotta do dis!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross speeds up, but she can't
pass the lead! Has she run out
of energy?!
The lead remains the same and... we have
a winner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What was supposed to be an easy
warm-up before the real deal turns
out to
be a fight to even place fifth...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What the hell... Why, after all that work,
am I still garbage?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I'm callin' it a day. I needa cool
off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to take a walk. As I stroll about, I
try to figure out the reason
behind
Tamamo Cross's inability to unleash her
strength during that
last race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I look up, I realize I'm in the same park
where I met Tamamo Cross.
And just like
that time, I can hear the sound of children
playing.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Over here, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I didn't come here to play, ya know.
You're all lucky you're
adorable. Can't say
no to—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess. This park reminds me of the one
near my house back home.
So when I'm
down in the dumps, I'll come here to clear
my head.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Tama? Whatcha doing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a minute, guys—we're havin' a chat
over here! Go on, have fun
without me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...The kids here are around the same age
as my siblings.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how the little scoundrels are
doin'... Same goes for my
folks... Hope
they're holdin' up okay.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah... More than anythin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I'm bein' honest, we're not exactly
swimmin' in money, but that
didn't matter
to us. Everyone was always smiling, and
every day was a
blast.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thing is... supportin' us costs money, so
Mom and Dad work
themselves to the
bone every day... I couldn't just sit around
and let
them handle everythin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tama! Let's buy some candy! I'm
super hungry right now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, ya know we can't afford it. 'Sides,
tonight's dinner is... grilled
fish cakes! You
sure you wanna fill up on sweets?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Sister
text_block_list.text: Wow! Tama's makin' grilled fish cakes?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Brother
text_block_list.text:
All right! You're right, Tama. I gotta save
room!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! Now let's get
goin'. Mom and Dad are
waitin' for us back
home!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Just you wait, kiddos. Someday I'll buy you as much candy as you want, and we'll be chowin' down on grilled steaks for dinner!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
After that, I got to thinkin' up ways I could
make my family's dreams
come true. And
eventually I landed on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If I can win all the races, I'll be super famous, right? And with that comes cash. After that, I'll be able to buy whatever my family wants!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My folks worked hard to get me into this
academy, so I gotta make it
worth the
price! That's why I gotta win! But...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: With my crappy runnin', not only am I losin', but I'm losing bad. I gotta admit it's a li'l... frustratin'.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...Tama? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whatcha doin' here, ya little rascals?
I thought I told youse guys
to go play.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
But we wanna see you run! Show us how
fast you are!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For cryin' out loud... You just think of me
as a toy, don'tcha? A'ight,
but just this
once. Back up, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ready, set... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross blasts off with a ferocity
that seems to send a crackle
through the
air. Yes, just like before... she is the
lightning disrupting
the evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Tama, you got even faster! You
were like, "BOOM!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And it looks like a blast!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It sure does, yeah?! Dat's why they call me
"White Lightning!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, it started with something my dad
said. He told me seein' me
zoomin' around
havin' a blast was like watchin' a streak of
white
lightning.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My whole family's convinced White
Lightning's gonna destroy the
competition
to become the fastest in Japan... And I
don't wanna
prove 'em wrong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could those words be the key to what's
holding her back?
